subject: op-spd
title: (R)OP.SPD.------ POL.P.
description: Diagram in SR(TRS)II-43 (Social Reality / Trans-Information, Level Two) closing the Level Two chapter with Braxton's distinction between collective forces and controlling forces of western culture: 'the difference between the concept of collective forces as opposed to controlling forces would have to do with the option spread that is available to white people … but the real controlling factors which really determine American — and western — policy are quite separate from this option spread.' (R)OP-SPD (the reality of option-spread) is crossed with POL-P (political particulars): the question is what option-spread produces in its actual instantiation when crossed with political-particulars — the (R) prefix marking that this is the actual option-spread available, not the marketed one. POL-P sits at the upper-center with DYM-F (dynamics fundamentals) on the upper-right. DEC (decision) anchors the upper-right margin. PART (participation) sits between subject and partner. EXP-CONT (experimental continuance) feeds in from the lower-left. MT-INFO (multi-information) sits centrally below. C-FO-ACT (composite focused activism) anchors the lower-right output. VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) and SOC-RT-DY (social-reality dynamics) form the lower upstream chain. Structural argument: option-spread-as-real crossed with political-particulars is mediated by participation as central hub, with experimental-continuance as upstream and social-reality-dynamics, vibrational-dynamics, multi-information as lower upstreams. The diagram exposes Braxton's structural diagnostic of the option-spread illusion: the productive output (composite-focused-activism, dynamics-fundamentals, decision) routes through participation, but participation in this configuration is shaped by political-particulars *before* it reaches activism — meaning the option-spread of the average white person is constrained to participation-within-particulars, not participation that could constitute composite-focused-activism. The diagram is the structural case for why controlling forces are *separate from* the option-spread.
